domain.invalidInput: reject non-finite or out-of-domain values in the normative reference

middleGreyReference.application: runtime scene-linear gain (uniform uSceneGain) applied before OCLog2; recorded in the sidecar transform
middleGreyReference.highlightBoundary: MATCH_SDR clips HLG scene light above 1 / tierGreyRatio (about 0.752 HLG signal)
middleGreyReference.hlgGreyLinear: 0.38^2 / 3 (ITU-R BT.2408 18% grey at 38% HLG signal, inverse BT.2100 HLG OETF)
middleGreyReference.sdrGreyLinear: 0.18 (inverse BT.709 OETF of the 18% grey code)

precision.rounding: no normative quantization; generated text uses 15 fractional decimal places
precision.transportBoundary: GLSL, DCTL, and LUT transports clamp to their declared domains

HLG10_BT2020.preTransform: inverse HLG OETF and BT.709-to-BT.2020 matrix (stream measured with BT.709 primaries despite its BT.2020 tag)

SDR_BT709_ISP.claimBoundary: ISP-derived; no source HDR, gamut, or bit-depth claim
SDR_BT709_ISP.preTransform: assumed inverse BT.709 OETF and BT.709-to-BT.2020 matrix
